clinic.name: Radiance Clinics
clinic.safety: Radiance AI Reception provides general information and booking support only. A qualified doctor must assess diagnosis, suitability and expected outcomes.
clinic.costGuidance: The final cost depends on the concern, treatment plan and, where applicable, procedure extent. The clinic team can provide an accurate estimate after assessment.

treatments.name: Hair Loss
treatments.description: Evaluation and care options for ongoing shedding, thinning and reduced density.

treatments.name: Hair Transplant
treatments.description: A consultation-led surgical hair restoration option. Suitability and graft planning require doctor assessment.

treatments.name: PRP
treatments.description: Platelet-rich plasma is one option doctors may consider as part of a personalised hair-care plan.

treatments.name: GFC
treatments.description: Growth-factor concentrate may be discussed after assessment for selected hair concerns.

treatments.name: Beard Transplant
treatments.description: Consultation-led restoration for beard density or shape concerns.

treatments.name: Acne
treatments.description: Clinical assessment for active acne and a personalised management plan.

treatments.name: Acne Scars
treatments.description: Assessment of scar type, skin condition and suitable procedure options.

treatments.name: Pigmentation
treatments.description: Doctor-led evaluation of uneven tone and dark spots before treatment planning.

treatments.name: Melasma
treatments.description: Long-term, clinically guided care for melasma after diagnosis.

treatments.name: Laser Treatments
treatments.description: Laser options vary by concern and skin type; assessment is essential.

treatments.name: Anti-ageing
treatments.description: Personalised consultation for age-related skin concerns and appropriate options.

treatments.name: General Skin
treatments.description: Consultation for a skin concern that needs further assessment.
